      forall Ns M, List.length Ns = im_nn Mm ->
      (forall j N T0, List.nth_error Ns j = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mm) τU Ns) j = Some T0 -> Γ ⊨ N : T0) ->
      Γ ⊨ M : ind_mty p D m Us Ns ->
      gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ M :: nil)) (elim_mctx p D m Mm Us ++ Γ).
  Proof.
    intros * HMm HMa * HNl HNs HMv.
    assert (Hrass : tele_ass (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU)) by (apply tele_ass_sub, (decl_closed_nparams_ass D Hc _ _ HMm)).
    apply gsub_of_list; [ constructor; exact HΓ | exact (elim_mctx_ass p D m Mm Us Hc HMm) | exact HMa
                        | rewrite List.length_app, length_elim_mctx; cbn; lia |].
    intros j N T0 HN HT.
    unfold elim_mctx in HT; change (ce_ass ?H0 :: ?R) with ((ce_ass H0 :: nil) ++ R) in HT.
    rewrite tele_insts_app in HT by (try exact Hrass; rewrite length_tele_sub; exact HNl).
    assert (Hl2 : List.length (tele_insts (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU) Id Ns) = im_nn Mm)
      by (rewrite length_tele_insts by exact Hrass; rewrite length_tele_sub, length_im_nparams; lia).
    destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases j (im_nn Mm)) as [Hk | Hk].
    - rewrite List.nth_error_app1 in HN by lia.
      rewrite List.nth_error_app1 in HT by (rewrite length_tele_insts by exact Hrass; rewrite length_tele_sub, length_im_nparams; lia).
      rewrite tele_insts_tele_sub in HT.
      rewrite (tele_insts_sb_eq _ _ τU) in HT by (intros x; cbn; apply sentry_sub_id).
      exact (HNs _ _ _ HN HT).
    - rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HN by lia.
      rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HT by (rewrite length_tele_insts by exact Hrass; rewrite length_tele_sub, length_im_nparams; lia).
      rewrite HNl in HN; rewrite length_tele_insts, length_tele_sub, length_im_nparams, HNl, Nat.min_id in HT by exact Hrass.
      destruct (j - im_nn Mm) as [| j'] eqn:Hk'; cbn in HN, HT; [| destruct j'; discriminate ].
      injection HN as <-; unfold tele_insts in HT; cbn in HT; injection HT as <-.
      rewrite ind_head_inst by (try exact Hc; try exact HUl; exact HNl).
      rewrite (List.map_ext (fun U => U[Id]) (fun U => U)), List.map_id by (intros; apply exp_sub_id).
      exact HMv.
  Qed.

The uniform parameters' values, as arguments of their telescope.
  Lemma U_gargs : forall a b, RU (env_args nil a) (env_args nil b) -> List.length a = ind_nu D -> List.length b = ind_nu D ->
      per_gargs (List.rev (ind_uparams D)) nil nil a b.
  Proof. intros * H La Lb; exact (uparams_of_env D HD Hc a b RU HRU La Lb H). Qed.

The Arguments Before a Position, Weakened to Their Non-Recursive

Ones, over Γ
  Lemma cargs_wk_ext : forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> forall gs1 gs2, gs = gs1 ++ gs2 ->
      cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ++ Γ ⊨ʷ (wk_pat (cargs_pat gs1)) : cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ++ Γ.
  Proof.
    intros k Mk c gs HMk Hcon.
    pose proof (vg_cargs_sem p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon) as HΨ.
    pose proof (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMk) as HPa.
    induction gs1 as [| g gs1 IH] using List.rev_ind; intros gs2 Heq.
    - cbn [cargs_ctx cargs_ctx_aux cargs_strat cargs_pat List.rev List.map List.app].
      destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ HPa (vid_params _ HD _ _ HMk) HΓ) as [HPΓ _].
      destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HPΓ) as [R HR].
      eapply rel_wk_under_ctx_intro; [ exact HR | exact HR | exact (rel_wk_id R) ].
    - rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Heq; cbn [List.app] in Heq.
      pose proof (IH _ Heq) as IHw.
      pose proof (cargs_prefix_sem D p Mk gs HΨ (gs1 ++ g :: nil) gs2 ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq)) as HC.
      assert (HCa : tele_ass (cargs_ctx p D Mk (gs1 ++ g :: nil) ++ im_params D Mk))
        by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact HPa ]).
      destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ HCa HC HΓ) as [HCΓ _].
      rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HCΓ.
      rewrite cargs_ctx_snoc, cargs_pat_snoc in *.
      destruct g as [A0 | t]; cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app wk_pat] in *.
      + rewrite cargs_strat_snoc_arg.
        assert (HA : List.nth_error (cargs_nonrec gs) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) = Some A0)
          by (rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
        destruct (vid_arg _ HD _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hcon HA) as (_ & j & HAv).
        assert (HSs : ⊨ nonrec_args_prefix gs (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ++ im_params D Mk)
          by (apply (vid_strat _ HD _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hcon); rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        rewrite Heq, <- nonrec_args_prefix_cargs_strat in HAv, HSs.
        assert (HSa : tele_ass (cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk))
          by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ rewrite cargs_strat_nonrec; apply List.Forall_rev, tele_ass_map_ass | exact HPa ]).
        pose proof (closed_app_valid _ _ _ _ _ HSa HSs HΓ HAv) as HAv'.
        rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HAv'.
        exact (rel_wk_under_ctx_q IHw HAv').
      + rewrite cargs_strat_snoc_rec.
        exact (rel_wk_under_ctx_compose _ _ _ _ _ (rel_wk_under_ctx_shift HCΓ) IHw).
  Qed.

The Canonical Uniform Parameters

The values u0 of Us at an environment C1 of Γ: the canonical relations of the group there, G its elements.
  Section Base.
    Variable (C1 : env) (u0 : list domain).
    Hypotheses (HC11 : RΓ C1 C1) (HUC : ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ u0).

    Lemma u0_len : List.length u0 = ind_nu D.
    Proof. rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ HUC); exact HUl. Qed.

    Lemma u0_env : RU (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0).
    Proof.
      destruct (us_vals C1 C1 HC11) as (u1 & u2 & Hu1 & Hu2 & H12).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Hu1 HUC) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Hu2 HUC) as ->.
      exact H12.
    Qed.

    Lemma u0_gargs : per_gargs (List.rev (ind_uparams D)) nil nil u0 u0.
    Proof. exact (U_gargs _ _ u0_env u0_len u0_len). Qed.

    Let nr := canon_nparams_rel D u0.
    Let ar := canon_args_rel D u0.
    Let dr := canon_doms_rel u0.
    #[local] Abbreviation Hcp := (vg_canon p D Hvg u0 u0_gargs u0_len).
    #[local] Abbreviation HnP := (icp_np_per _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HnI := (icp_np_iff _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HaP := (icp_arg_per _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HaI := (icp_arg_iff _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HdP := (icp_dom_per _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HdI := (icp_dom_iff _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation Had := (vg_adm p D Hvg u0 u0 u0_gargs u0_len u0_gargs).
    Let G := grp_rel p D u0 nr ar dr.

The environments related to C1: their values of Us are related to u0, so admissible beside it.
    Lemma us_class : forall B, RΓ B C1 -> exists u, ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B ↘ u /\ RU (env_args nil u) (env_args nil u0).
    Proof.
      intros B HB1; destruct (us_vals B C1 HB1) as (u & u' & Hu & Hu' & H).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Hu' HUC) as ->; eauto.
    Qed.

    Lemma adm_of_ru : forall w, RU (env_args nil w) (env_args nil u0) -> List.length w = ind_nu D -> adm_uparams D u0 nr ar dr w.
    Proof.
      intros w H Lw.
      assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
      exact (vg_adm p D Hvg u0 w u0_gargs u0_len (U_gargs _ _ (symmetry H) u0_len Lw)).
    Qed.

The uniform parameters an eliminator carries, of the class of u0: as the model reads them.
    Lemma mrefs_of_ru : forall w, RU (env_args nil w) (env_args nil u0) -> List.length w = ind_nu D -> mrefs_ok p D w.
    Proof.
      intros w Hw Lw j Mj HMj.
      assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
      assert (Hww : RU (env_args nil w) (env_args nil w)) by (etransitivity; [ exact Hw | symmetry; exact Hw ]).
      destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qc kc Is vm] eqn:Hh.
      - exists (p, j, w); eapply eval_mref_decl; [ exact Hl | exact HMj | exact Hh ].
      - destruct (view_target_decl P p D HP HPD j Mj HMj qc kc Is vm Hh) as (Dq & Mk' & pm & Hq & _ & _ & _).
        destruct (vg_view_args_values p D Hvg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hq w w (U_gargs _ _ Hww Lw Lw) Lw)
          as (cs & _ & Ecs & _ & _).
        exists (qc, kc, cs); eapply eval_mref_view; [ exact Hl | exact HMj | exact Hh | exact Ecs ].
    Qed.

    Lemma ups_ok : forall w1 w2, RU (env_args nil w1) (env_args nil u0) -> RU (env_args nil w2) (env_args nil u0) ->
        List.length w1 = ind_nu D -> List.length w2 = ind_nu D ->
        elim_ups_ok p D u0 (canon_nparams_rel D u0) (canon_args_rel D u0) (canon_doms_rel u0) w1 w2.
    Proof.
      intros * H1 H2 L1 L2.
      assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
      assert (H12 : RU (env_args nil w1) (env_args nil w2)) by (etransitivity; [ exact H1 | symmetry; exact H2 ]).
      pose proof (U_gargs _ _ H12 L1 L2) as Hg12.
      constructor; [ exact L1 | exact L2 | exact (adm_of_ru w1 H1 L1) | exact (adm_of_ru w2 H2 L2)
                   | exact (mrefs_of_ru w1 H1 L1) | exact (mrefs_of_ru w2 H2 L2) |].
      intros * HMj Ea Eb Hq.
      inversion Ea as [? ? ? D1 M1 pm1 Hl1 HM1 Hh1 | ? ? ? D1 M1 qc1 k1 Is1 vm1 cs1 Hl1 HM1 Hh1 Ec1]; subst;
        rewrite Hl in Hl1; injection Hl1 as <-; rewrite HMj in HM1; injection HM1 as <-;
        inversion Eb as [? ? ? D2 M2 pm2 Hl2 HM2 Hh2 | ? ? ? D2 M2 qc2 k2 Is2 vm2 cs2 Hl2 HM2 Hh2 Ec2]; subst;
        rewrite Hl in Hl2; injection Hl2 as <-; rewrite HMj in HM2; injection HM2 as <-; try congruence.
      - rewrite Hl in Hq; injection Hq as <-.
        intros s; exact (per_gargs_top _ _ _ _ _ Hg12 ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact L1) s).
      - rewrite Hh1 in Hh2; injection Hh2; intros; subst.
        destruct (vg_view_args_values p D Hvg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh1 Hq w1 w2 Hg12 L1) as (c0 & c0' & E0 & E0' & Hc0).
        pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0 Ec1) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0' Ec2) as ->.
        destruct (view_target_decl P p D HP HPD j Mj HMj _ _ _ _ Hh1) as (Dq' & Mk' & pm & Hq' & _ & _ & HIl).
        rewrite Hq in Hq'; injection Hq' as <-.
        intros s; exact (per_gargs_top _ _ _ _ _ Hc0 ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev, (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ec1), HIl; reflexivity) s).
    Qed.

A closed telescope's environment over the values of the uniform parameters at an environment, against the canonical one.
    Lemma closed_pre_base : forall Pre RK, tele_ass (Pre ++ ind_uparams D) -> ⊨ Pre ++ ind_uparams D ->
        EF Pre ++ ind_uparams D ≈ Pre ++ ind_uparams D ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RK ->
        forall B u zs, RU (env_args nil u) (env_args nil u0) -> List.length u = ind_nu D ->
        per_gargs (List.rev Pre) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) zs zs -> List.length zs = List.length Pre ->
        RK (env_args (env_args B u) zs) (env_args nil (u0 ++ zs)).
    Proof.
      intros * HKa HK HRK * H10 Lu1 Hg00 Lz0.
      assert (HPa : tele_ass Pre) by (apply List.Forall_app in HKa as [H _]; exact H).
      assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
      pose proof (U_gargs _ _ H10 Lu1 u0_len) as Hg10.
      assert (HKr : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev Pre) ++ ind_uparams D) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HK).
      pose proof (per_gargs_base _ _ _ HRU HKr (List.Forall_rev HPa) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0)
                    (env_args nil u) (env_args nil u0) zs zs u0_env (symmetry H10) u0_env Hg00) as Hgb.
      rewrite <- env_args_app.
      eapply (closed_env_base _ _ _ _ nil nil); [ exact HKa | exact HK | exact HRK
                                                | rewrite !List.length_app; unfold ind_nu in Lu1; lia
                                                | rewrite !List.length_app; pose proof u0_len as L0; unfold ind_nu in L0; lia |].
      apply (gargs_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HRK HK); [ rewrite !List.length_app; unfold ind_nu in Lu1; lia |].
      rewrite List.rev_app_distr; apply per_gargs_app_intro;
        [ rewrite List.length_rev; exact Lu1 | exact Hg10 | exact Hgb ].
    Qed.

Instances of a Closed Telescope

Arguments related at a closed telescope over the canonical uniform parameters are related at its instance, over any related environments whose uniform parameters are related to the canonical ones, and conversely.
    Lemma cv_gen : forall Pre, tele_ass (Pre ++ ind_uparams D) -> ⊨ Pre ++ ind_uparams D -> ⊨ tele_sub Pre τU ++ Γ ->
        forall B1 B2 u1 u2, RΓ B1 B2 ->
        ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B1 ↘ u1 -> ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B2 ↘ u2 ->
        RU (env_args nil u1) (env_args nil u0) -> RU (env_args nil u2) (env_args nil u0) ->
        forall zs zs', per_gargs (List.rev Pre) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) zs zs' -> List.length zs = List.length Pre ->
          per_gargs (List.rev (tele_sub Pre τU)) B1 B2 zs zs'.
    Proof.
      induction Pre as [| e Pre IH]; intros HKa HK HS * HB Hu1 Hu2 H10 H20 zs zs' Hg Hlz.
      - destruct zs; cbn in Hlz; [| discriminate ]; inversion Hg; subst; constructor.
      - assert (He : exists A, e = ce_ass A) by (inversion HKa as [| ? ? He _]; exact He).
        destruct He as [X ->].
        assert (HKa' : tele_ass (Pre ++ ind_uparams D)) by (inversion HKa; assumption).
        assert (HPa : tele_ass Pre) by (apply List.Forall_app in HKa' as [H _]; exact H).
        pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Hu1) as Lu1; rewrite HUl in Lu1.
        assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
        destruct (List.exists_last (l := zs) ltac:(intros ->; cbn in Hlz; discriminate)) as (zs0 & x & ->).
        rewrite List.length_app in Hlz; cbn in Hlz.
        assert (Lz0 : List.length zs0 = List.length Pre) by lia; clear Hlz.
        pose proof (per_gargs_length _ _ _ _ _ Hg) as [Lzz _].
        rewrite List.length_app in Lzz; cbn [List.length] in Lzz.
        destruct (List.exists_last (l := zs') ltac:(intros ->; cbn in Lzz; lia)) as (zs0' & x' & ->).
        rewrite List.length_app in Lzz; cbn in Lzz.
        cbn [List.rev] in Hg.
        assert (Lr : List.length zs0 = List.length (List.rev Pre)) by (rewrite List.length_rev; exact Lz0).
        assert (Lr' : List.length zs0' = List.length (List.rev Pre)) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
        destruct (per_gargs_app (List.rev Pre) (ce_ass X :: nil) _ _ zs0 zs0' (x :: nil) (x' :: nil) Lr Hg Lr') as [Hg0 Hgx].
        inversion Hgx as [| ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? R0 HX0 Hx _]; subst.
        cbn [tele_sub centry_sub List.rev List.app] in HS |- *.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HS) as [j HXi].
        pose proof (rel_ctx_wf_tail HS) as HS'.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HK) as [j' HXc].
        pose proof (rel_ctx_wf_tail HK) as HK'.
        pose proof (IH HKa' HK' HS' _ _ _ _ HB Hu1 Hu2 H10 H20 _ _ Hg0 Lz0) as IHz.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HS') as [RS HRS].
        assert (HE : RS (env_args B1 zs0) (env_args B2 zs0'))
          by (eapply gargs_env_rel_gen; [ exact HRΓ | exact HRS | exact HS' | exact HB | rewrite length_tele_sub; exact Lz0 | exact IHz ]).
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRS HXi _ _ HE) as (t1 & t2 & Et1 & Et2 & [R12 HR12]).
        assert (HPS : PER RS) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRS).
        assert (HEE : RS (env_args B1 zs0) (env_args B1 zs0)) by (etransitivity; [ exact HE | symmetry; exact HE ]).
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HK') as [RK HRK].
        assert (HKr : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev Pre) ++ ind_uparams D) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HK').
        pose proof (per_gargs_refl_l _ _ _ HRU HKr (List.Forall_rev HPa) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) zs0 zs0' u0_env Hg0) as Hg00.
        pose proof (closed_pre_base Pre RK HKa' HK' HRK B1 u1 zs0 H10 Lu1 Hg00 Lz0) as HK1.
        destruct (closed_typ_inst Pre (ind_uparams D) Γ X j' τU RΓ RK RS B1 zs0 (env_args B1 u1) (env_args nil (u0 ++ zs0))
                    HKa' HK' Ua Usem HΓ HRΓ HRK HRS HXc (gsub_valid gsub_U) HEE Lz0
                    (eval_sb_of_list _ _ _ _ _ (eval_sub_id B1) Hu1) HK1)
          as (a & c & Ea & Ec & [R1c HR1c]).
        assert (a = t1) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        destruct HX0 as [c0 c0' Ec0 Ec0' HR0].
        rewrite <- env_args_app in Ec0.
        assert (c0 = c) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        assert (E1 : R12 <~> R1c) by (eapply per_univ_elem_right_irrel; [ exact HR12 | exact HR1c ]).
        assert (E2 : R1c <~> R0) by (eapply per_univ_elem_chain_iff; [ exact HR1c | exact HR0 ]).
        destruct (per_univ_elem_to_nat _ _ _ _ HR12) as [n Hn].
        apply (per_gargs_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ n R12).
        + rewrite List.length_rev, length_tele_sub; exact Lz0.
        + exact IHz.
        + exact (mk_rel_mod_eval t1 t2 Et1 Et2 Hn).
        + apply E1, E2; exact Hx.
    Qed.

    Lemma cv_gen_rev : forall Pre, tele_ass (Pre ++ ind_uparams D) -> ⊨ Pre ++ ind_uparams D -> ⊨ tele_sub Pre τU ++ Γ ->
        forall B1 B2 u1, RΓ B1 B2 ->
        ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B1 ↘ u1 -> RU (env_args nil u1) (env_args nil u0) ->
        forall zs zs', per_gargs (List.rev (tele_sub Pre τU)) B1 B2 zs zs' -> List.length zs = List.length Pre ->
          per_gargs (List.rev Pre) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) zs zs'.
    Proof.
      induction Pre as [| e Pre IH]; intros HKa HK HS * HB Hu1 H10 zs zs' Hg Hlz.
      - destruct zs; cbn in Hlz; [| discriminate ]; inversion Hg; subst; constructor.
      - assert (He : exists A, e = ce_ass A) by (inversion HKa as [| ? ? He _]; exact He).
        destruct He as [X ->].
        assert (HKa' : tele_ass (Pre ++ ind_uparams D)) by (inversion HKa; assumption).
        assert (HPa : tele_ass Pre) by (apply List.Forall_app in HKa' as [H _]; exact H).
        pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Hu1) as Lu1; rewrite HUl in Lu1.
        assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
        destruct (List.exists_last (l := zs) ltac:(intros ->; cbn in Hlz; discriminate)) as (zs0 & x & ->).
        rewrite List.length_app in Hlz; cbn in Hlz.
        assert (Lz0 : List.length zs0 = List.length Pre) by lia; clear Hlz.
        pose proof (per_gargs_length _ _ _ _ _ Hg) as [Lzz _].
        rewrite List.length_app in Lzz; cbn [List.length] in Lzz.
        destruct (List.exists_last (l := zs') ltac:(intros ->; cbn in Lzz; lia)) as (zs0' & x' & ->).
        rewrite List.length_app in Lzz; cbn in Lzz.
        cbn [tele_sub centry_sub List.rev List.app] in HS, Hg |- *.
        assert (Lr : List.length zs0 = List.length (List.rev (tele_sub Pre τU))) by (rewrite List.length_rev, length_tele_sub; exact Lz0).
        assert (Lr' : List.length zs0' = List.length (List.rev (tele_sub Pre τU))) by (rewrite List.length_rev, length_tele_sub; lia).
        destruct (per_gargs_app (List.rev (tele_sub Pre τU)) _ _ _ zs0 zs0' (x :: nil) (x' :: nil) Lr Hg Lr') as [Hg0 Hgx].
        inversion Hgx as [| ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? R0 HX0 Hx _]; subst.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HS) as [j HXi].
        pose proof (rel_ctx_wf_tail HS) as HS'.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HK) as [j' HXc].
        pose proof (rel_ctx_wf_tail HK) as HK'.
        pose proof (IH HKa' HK' HS' _ _ _ HB Hu1 H10 _ _ Hg0 Lz0) as IHz.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HS') as [RS HRS].
        assert (HE : RS (env_args B1 zs0) (env_args B2 zs0'))
          by (eapply gargs_env_rel_gen; [ exact HRΓ | exact HRS | exact HS' | exact HB | rewrite length_tele_sub; exact Lz0 | exact Hg0 ]).
        assert (HPS : PER RS) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRS).
        assert (HEE : RS (env_args B1 zs0) (env_args B1 zs0)) by (etransitivity; [ exact HE | symmetry; exact HE ]).
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HK') as [RK HRK].
        assert (HPK : PER RK) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRK).
        assert (HKr : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev Pre) ++ ind_uparams D) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HK').
        pose proof (per_gargs_refl_l _ _ _ HRU HKr (List.Forall_rev HPa) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) zs0 zs0' u0_env IHz) as Hg00.
        pose proof (closed_pre_base Pre RK HKa' HK' HRK B1 u1 zs0 H10 Lu1 Hg00 Lz0) as HK1.
        destruct (closed_typ_inst Pre (ind_uparams D) Γ X j' τU RΓ RK RS B1 zs0 (env_args B1 u1) (env_args nil (u0 ++ zs0))
                    HKa' HK' Ua Usem HΓ HRΓ HRK HRS HXc (gsub_valid gsub_U) HEE Lz0
                    (eval_sb_of_list _ _ _ _ _ (eval_sub_id B1) Hu1) HK1)
          as (a & c & Ea & Ec & [R1c HR1c]).
        destruct HX0 as [a0 a0' Ea0 Ea0' HR0].
        assert (a0 = a) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
The closed entry at the two canonical prefixes.
        assert (HKK : RK (env_args nil (u0 ++ zs0)) (env_args nil (u0 ++ zs0'))).
        { apply (gargs_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HRK HK'); [ rewrite !List.length_app; pose proof u0_len as L0; unfold ind_nu in L0; lia |].
          rewrite List.rev_app_distr; apply per_gargs_app_intro;
            [ rewrite List.length_rev; exact u0_len | exact u0_gargs | exact IHz ]. }
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRK HXc _ _ HKK) as (c1 & c1' & Ec1 & Ec1' & [Rc HRc]).
        assert (c1 = c) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        assert (E1 : R0 <~> R1c) by (eapply per_univ_elem_right_irrel; [ exact HR0 | exact HR1c ]).
        assert (E2 : R1c <~> Rc) by (eapply per_univ_elem_chain_iff; [ exact HR1c | exact HRc ]).
        destruct (per_univ_elem_to_nat _ _ _ _ HRc) as [n Hn].
        apply (per_gargs_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ n Rc).
        + rewrite List.length_rev; exact Lz0.
        + exact IHz.
        + rewrite env_args_app in Ec1, Ec1'; exact (mk_rel_mod_eval c c1' Ec1 Ec1' Hn).
        + apply E2, E1; exact Hx.
    Qed.

A Member's Motive Context

The member k's non-uniform parameters at Us, and its type there: related at the canonical relations, read through the closed telescope of its parameters.
    Section Member.
      Variable (k : nat) (Mk : imember).
      Hypothesis (HMk : ind_member D k = Some Mk).
      Hypothesis (HMm : ⊨ elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ).
      Let T := List.rev (im_nparams Mk).
      Let IT := ind_mty p D k (List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk)]ʷ) Us) (vars_from 0 (im_nn Mk)).

      Lemma mctx_split : elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ = (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) τU ++ Γ) ▹ IT.
      Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

      Lemma m_HNt : ⊨ tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) τU ++ Γ.
      Proof. exact (rel_ctx_wf_tail HMm). Qed.

      Lemma m_Pa : tele_ass (im_nparams Mk ++ ind_uparams D).
      Proof. exact (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMk). Qed.

      Lemma m_Ps : ⊨ im_nparams Mk ++ ind_uparams D.
      Proof. exact (vid_params _ HD _ _ HMk). Qed.

      Lemma m_T_len : List.length T = im_nn Mk.
      Proof. unfold T; rewrite List.length_rev; reflexivity. Qed.

Canonically related non-uniform parameters are related at their closed telescope at u0, and conversely.
      Lemma nparams_closed_of_canon : forall ns ns', tele_rel (nr k) T ns ns' ->
          per_gargs (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) ns ns'.
      Proof.
        intros * Hns.
        destruct (sort_value D HD u0 u0_gargs u0_len) as [a0 Ha0].
        pose proof Hns as H0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in H0; destruct H0 as (Ln & _ & _).
        pose proof (nr_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk u0 u0 a0 u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 (im_nn Mk) ns ns' (le_n _)
                      ltac:(apply tele_rel_pre in Hns; rewrite m_T_len in Hns; exact Hns)) as H.
        rewrite List.firstn_all2 in H by (rewrite List.length_rev; reflexivity); exact H.
      Qed.

      Lemma canon_of_nparams_closed : forall ns ns', List.length ns = im_nn Mk ->
          per_gargs (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) ns ns' -> tele_rel (nr k) T ns ns'.
      Proof.
        intros * Ln Hg0.
        refine (gargs_tele_canon T (nr k) (env_args nil u0) _ (env_args nil u0) ns ns' Hg0 ltac:(rewrite m_T_len; exact Ln)).
        intros j A pre HA.
        unfold nr, canon_nparams_rel; rewrite (nth_ctyp_eq _ _ _ _ _ HMk HA), <- env_args_app; reflexivity.
      Qed.

      Lemma cv_nparams : forall B1 B2 u1 u2, RΓ B1 B2 ->
          ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B1 ↘ u1 -> ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B2 ↘ u2 ->
          RU (env_args nil u1) (env_args nil u0) -> RU (env_args nil u2) (env_args nil u0) ->
          forall ns ns', tele_rel (nr k) T ns ns' ->
          per_gargs (List.rev (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) τU)) B1 B2 ns ns'.
      Proof.
        intros * HB Hu1 Hu2 H10 H20 * Hns.
        pose proof Hns as H0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in H0; destruct H0 as (Ln & _ & _).
        exact (cv_gen (im_nparams Mk) m_Pa m_Ps m_HNt B1 B2 u1 u2 HB Hu1 Hu2 H10 H20 ns ns'
                 (nparams_closed_of_canon _ _ Hns) ltac:(rewrite m_T_len in Ln; rewrite length_im_nparams; exact Ln)).
      Qed.

      Lemma cv_nparams_rev : forall B1 B2 u1, RΓ B1 B2 ->
          ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B1 ↘ u1 -> RU (env_args nil u1) (env_args nil u0) ->
          forall ns ns', List.length ns = im_nn Mk ->
          per_gargs (List.rev (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) τU)) B1 B2 ns ns' -> tele_rel (nr k) T ns ns'.
      Proof.
        intros * HB Hu1 H10 * Ln Hg0.
        apply canon_of_nparams_closed; [ exact Ln |].
        exact (cv_gen_rev (im_nparams Mk) m_Pa m_Ps m_HNt B1 B2 u1 HB Hu1 H10 ns ns' Hg0
                 ltac:(rewrite length_im_nparams; exact Ln)).
      Qed.

The relation of the member's type at an environment of the class of C1 and canonically related non-uniform parameters: the group's at k, at the canonical bases.
      Lemma mctx_head_rel : forall B1 B2 u1, RΓ B1 B2 ->
          ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ B1 ↘ u1 -> RU (env_args nil u1) (env_args nil u0) ->
          forall RS, EF tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) τU ++ Γ ≈ tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) τU ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RS ->
          forall ns ns', tele_rel (nr k) T ns ns' -> RS (env_args B1 ns) (env_args B1 ns) ->
          forall t1 t2 (i : uidx) R, ⟦ IT ⟧ env_args B1 ns ↘ t1 -> ⟦ IT ⟧ env_args B2 ns' ↘ t2 ->
          DF t1 ≈ t2 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R -> (R <~> G k u0 u0 ns ns').
      Proof.
        intros * HB Hu1 H10 RS HRS * Hns HEE * Et1 Et2 HR.
        destruct (sort_value D HD u0 u0_gargs u0_len) as [a0 Ha0].
        assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
        pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Hu1) as Lu1; rewrite HUl in Lu1.
        pose proof Hns as H0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in H0; destruct H0 as (Ln & Ln' & _).
        rewrite m_T_len in Ln, Ln'.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env m_Ps) as [RK HRK].
        assert (HPK : PER RK) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRK).
        destruct (mty_vars_valid p D Hvg Hcv k Mk HMk) as [jx HX].
The closed side.
        pose proof (params_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk u0 u0 a0 ns ns' u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 Hns) as Hgc.
        assert (HKc : RK (env_args nil (u0 ++ ns)) (env_args nil (u0 ++ ns'))).
        { apply (gargs_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HRK m_Ps); [| exact Hgc ].
          rewrite !List.length_app, length_im_nparams; pose proof u0_len as L0; unfold ind_nu in L0; lia. }
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRK HX _ _ HKc) as (c1 & c2 & Ec1 & Ec2 & [Rc HRc]).
        assert (Ev : forall zs, List.length zs = im_nn Mk -> ⟦ vars_from 0 (im_nn Mk) ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_args nil (u0 ++ zs) ↘ zs).
        { intros zs Lz; rewrite env_args_app.
          pose proof (eval_vars_from_args zs (env_args nil u0) nil) as H; rewrite List.app_nil_r in H; cbn [List.length] in H.
          rewrite Lz in H; exact H. }
        pose proof (member_type_rel P p D HP HPD k Mk u0 u0 (im_nparams Mk) RK ns ns' (im_nn Mk) 0 (vars_from 0 (im_nn Mk))
                      ns ns' c1 c2 jx Rc HMk u0_len u0_gargs m_Ps HRK ltac:(rewrite length_im_nparams; exact Ln)
                      ltac:(rewrite length_im_nparams; exact Ln') ltac:(cbn; lia) HKc (Ev _ Ln) (Ev _ Ln') Ec1 Ec2 HRc) as ERc.
The left side, against the closed one.
        assert (Hg00 : per_gargs (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0) ns ns)
          by exact (nparams_closed_of_canon _ _ (nparams_rel_refl_l p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI k Mk HMk _ _ Hns)).
        pose proof (closed_pre_base (im_nparams Mk) RK m_Pa m_Ps HRK B1 u1 ns H10 Lu1 Hg00
                      ltac:(rewrite length_im_nparams; exact Ln)) as HK1.
        destruct (closed_typ_inst (im_nparams Mk) (ind_uparams D) Γ _ jx τU RΓ RK RS B1 ns (env_args B1 u1)
                    (env_args nil (u0 ++ ns)) m_Pa m_Ps Ua Usem HΓ HRΓ HRK HRS HX (gsub_valid gsub_U) HEE
                    ltac:(rewrite length_im_nparams; exact Ln) (eval_sb_of_list _ _ _ _ _ (eval_sub_id B1) Hu1) HK1)
          as (a & c & Ea & Ec & [R1c HR1c]).
        unfold τU in Ea; rewrite length_im_nparams, (mty_vars_inst p D k Mk Us Hc HUl) in Ea; fold IT in Ea.
        assert (a = t1) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        assert (c = c1) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        assert (E1 : R <~> R1c) by (eapply per_univ_elem_right_irrel; [ exact HR | exact HR1c ]).
        assert (E2 : R1c <~> Rc) by (eapply per_univ_elem_chain_iff; [ exact HR1c | exact HRc ]).
        etransitivity; [ exact E1 | etransitivity; [ exact E2 | exact ERc ] ].
      Qed.

The motive's context at two environments of the class of C1, at canonically related non-uniform parameters and elements of the member at any bases.
      Lemma cv_mctx : forall B1 B2, RΓ B1 C1 -> RΓ B2 C1 ->
          forall RM, EF elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RM ->
          forall ns ns' u u' m m', tele_rel (nr k) T ns ns' -> G k u u' ns ns' m m' ->
            RM (env_args B1 (ns ++ m :: nil)) (env_args B2 (ns' ++ m' :: nil)).
      Proof.
        intros * HB1 HB2 RM HRM * Hns Hm.
        assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
        assert (HB : RΓ B1 B2) by (etransitivity; [ exact HB1 | symmetry; exact HB2 ]).
        destruct (us_class B1 HB1) as (u1 & Hu1 & H10); destruct (us_class B2 HB2) as (u2 & Hu2 & H20).
        pose proof Hns as H0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in H0; destruct H0 as (Ln & _ & _); rewrite m_T_len in Ln.
        pose proof (cv_nparams B1 B2 u1 u2 HB Hu1 Hu2 H10 H20 ns ns' Hns) as Hg.
        assert (LNt : List.length (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) τU) = im_nn Mk) by (rewrite length_tele_sub; reflexivity).
        pose proof HMm as HM'; rewrite mctx_split in HM'.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HM') as [j HIT].
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env m_HNt) as [RN HRN].
        assert (HPN : PER RN) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRN).
        assert (HE : RN (env_args B1 ns) (env_args B2 ns'))
          by (eapply gargs_env_rel_gen; [ exact HRΓ | exact HRN | exact m_HNt | exact HB | lia | exact Hg ]).
        assert (HEE : RN (env_args B1 ns) (env_args B1 ns)) by (etransitivity; [ exact HE | symmetry; exact HE ]).
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRN HIT _ _ HE) as (t1 & t2 & Et1 & Et2 & [R12 HR12]).
        pose proof (mctx_head_rel B1 B2 u1 HB Hu1 H10 RN HRN ns ns' Hns HEE t1 t2 j R12 Et1 Et2 HR12) as ER.
        eapply gargs_env_rel_gen; [ exact HRΓ | exact HRM | exact HMm | exact HB | rewrite List.length_app, length_elim_mctx; cbn; lia |].
        unfold elim_mctx; cbn [List.rev].
        destruct (per_univ_elem_to_nat _ _ _ _ HR12) as [n Hn].
        apply (per_gargs_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ n R12);
          [ rewrite List.length_rev, length_tele_sub; exact Ln | exact Hg | exact (mk_rel_mod_eval _ _ Et1 Et2 Hn) |].
        apply ER.
        exact (ind_rel_rebase p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI k u u' u0 u0 ns ns' m m' Had Had Had Hm).
      Qed.
    End Member.

    #[local] Abbreviation tsym := (nparams_rel_sym p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI).
    #[local] Abbreviation ttrans := (nparams_rel_trans p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI).
    #[local] Abbreviation trefl_l := (nparams_rel_refl_l p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI).
    #[local] Abbreviation trefl_r := (nparams_rel_refl_r p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI).
    #[local] Abbreviation isym := (proj1 (ind_rel_sym_all p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (okr_at D u0 nr))).
    #[local] Abbreviation itrans := (proj1 (ind_rel_trans_all p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (okr_at D u0 nr))).
    #[local] Abbreviation iidx := (ind_rel_idx p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (okr_at D u0 nr)).
    #[local] Abbreviation ins := (ind_rel_ns p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (okr_at D u0 nr)).

The type of a scrutinee of the member m at C1 and an environment related to it: its relation is the group's at m, at the canonical bases, the values of the non-uniform parameters related canonically.
    Lemma scrut_rel : forall m Mm, ind_member D m = Some Mm -> ⊨ elim_mctx p D m Mm Us ++ Γ ->
        forall Ns, List.length Ns = im_nn Mm -> gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id Ns) (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU ++ Γ) ->
        forall C2', RΓ C1 C2' -> forall ns ns', ⟦ Ns ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ ns -> ⟦ Ns ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C2' ↘ ns' ->
        forall t t' (i : uidx) R, ⟦ ind_mty p D m Us Ns ⟧ C1 ↘ t -> ⟦ ind_mty p D m Us Ns ⟧ C2' ↘ t' ->
        DF t ≈ t' ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R ->
        tele_rel (nr m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ns ns' /\ (R <~> G m u0 u0 ns ns').
    Proof.
      intros * HMm HMa * HNl HgN * HC2 * Ens Ens' * Et Et' HR.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      assert (HC22 : RΓ C2' C2') by (etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact HC2 | exact HC2 ]).
      pose proof HMa as HM'; rewrite (mctx_split m Mm) in HM'.
      destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HM') as [jI HIT].
      pose proof (rel_ctx_wf_tail HMa) as HNt.
      destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HNt) as [RS HRS].
      assert (HPS : PER RS) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRS).
      assert (Eτ1 : ⟦ sb_of_list Id Ns ⟧s C1 ↘ env_args C1 ns) by (apply eval_sb_of_list; [ apply eval_sub_id | exact Ens ]).
      assert (Eτ2 : ⟦ sb_of_list Id Ns ⟧s C2' ↘ env_args C2' ns') by (apply eval_sb_of_list; [ apply eval_sub_id | exact Ens' ]).
      pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_at' (gsub_valid HgN) HRΓ HRS _ _ _ _ HC2 Eτ1 Eτ2) as HE.
      assert (HE11 : RS (env_args C1 ns) (env_args C1 ns)) by (etransitivity; [ exact HE | symmetry; exact HE ]).
      assert (Ln : List.length ns = im_nn Mm) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ens); exact HNl).
      assert (Ln' : List.length ns' = im_nn Mm) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ens'); exact HNl).
      assert (Hta : tele_ass (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU))
        by (apply tele_ass_sub, (decl_closed_nparams_ass D Hc _ _ HMm)).
      assert (HNr : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU)) ++ Γ) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HNt).
      assert (HRSr : EF List.rev (List.rev (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU)) ++ Γ ≈ List.rev (List.rev (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU)) ++ Γ
                       ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RS) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HRS).
      assert (Lt : List.length (List.rev (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) τU)) = im_nn Mm)
        by (rewrite List.length_rev, length_tele_sub; reflexivity).
      destruct (rel_gargs _ _ _ _ HRΓ HNr (List.Forall_rev Hta) HRSr _ _ _ _ ltac:(rewrite Lt; exact Ln) ltac:(rewrite Lt; exact Ln') HE)
        as [_ Hg].
      pose proof (cv_nparams_rev m Mm HMm HMa C1 C2' u0 HC2 HUC u0_env ns ns' Ln Hg) as Hns.
      destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRS HIT _ _ HE) as (b1 & b2 & Eb1 & Eb2 & [R12 HR12]).
      pose proof (mctx_head_rel m Mm HMm C1 C2' u0 HC2 HUC u0_env RS HRS ns ns' Hns HE11 b1 b2 _ R12 Eb1 Eb2 HR12) as HG.
      destruct (typ_inst_link _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HIT HRΓ (gsub_valid HgN) HC22 Eτ2) as (a & b & Ea & Eb & [R2 HR2]).
      rewrite ind_head_inst in Ea by (try exact Hc; try exact HUl; exact HNl).
      rewrite (List.map_ext (fun U => U[Id]) (fun U => U)), List.map_id in Ea by (intros; apply exp_sub_id).
      assert (a = t') as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
      assert (b = b2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
      destruct (per_univ_elem_trans_any _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HR HR2) as (R'' & HR'' & ER).
      assert (E2 : R'' <~> R12) by (eapply per_univ_elem_left_irrel; [ exact HR'' | exact HR12 ]).
      split; [ exact Hns |].
      etransitivity; [ exact ER | etransitivity; [ exact E2 | exact HG ] ].
    Qed.

A Constructor's Arguments, Canonically

Arguments related canonically at the bases u0, after the stored non-uniform parameters X and X' of the two constructors, are related at the closed telescope of their types there.
    Section ConCanon.
      Variable (k : nat) (Mk : imember) (c : String.string) (gs : list carg).
      Hypotheses (HMk : ind_member D k = Some Mk) (Hcon : ind_con Mk c = Some gs).
      Let HΨ := vg_cargs_sem p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon.
      Let T := List.rev (im_nparams Mk).

      Lemma cargs_gargs : forall X X' vs vs',
          tele_rel (nr k) T X X' ->
          tele_rel (ar k X c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs') ->
          con_args_rel p D (okr_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 X X' gs vs vs' ->
          forall n, n <= List.length gs ->
          per_gargs (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk (List.firstn n gs))) (env_args nil (u0 ++ X)) (env_args nil (u0 ++ X'))
            (List.firstn n vs) (List.firstn n vs').
      Proof.
        intros * Hab Har Hia.
        destruct (sort_value D HD u0 u0_gargs u0_len) as [a0 Ha0].
        pose proof (trefl_l _ _ HMk _ _ Hab) as Haa.
        destruct (con_args_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia) as [Hlv Hlv'].
        pose proof Hab as H0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in H0; destruct H0 as (Lna & Lnb & _).
        unfold T in Lna, Lnb; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in Lna, Lnb.
        pose proof (params_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk u0 u0 a0 X X' u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 Hab) as Hpg.
        pose proof (params_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk u0 u0 a0 X X u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 Haa) as Hpgd.
        induction n as [| n IH]; intros Hn; [ cbn; constructor |].
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' gs n ltac:(lia)) as [g Hg].
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' vs n ltac:(lia)) as [x Hx].
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' vs' n ltac:(lia)) as [x' Hx'].
        assert (Heq : gs = List.firstn n gs ++ g :: List.skipn (S n) gs)
          by (rewrite <- (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ Hg), List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
        assert (Lk : List.length (List.firstn n gs) = n) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        set (gs1 := List.firstn n gs) in *.
        set (fa := List.firstn n vs); set (fa' := List.firstn n vs').
        assert (Lfa : List.length fa = n) by (unfold fa; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (Lfa' : List.length fa' = n) by (unfold fa'; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        pose proof (IH ltac:(lia)) as IHk.
        rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hg), (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hx), (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hx').
        fold gs1 fa fa'.
        rewrite cargs_ctx_snoc, List.rev_app_distr.
The prefix's context, and the entry's type there.
        pose proof (cargs_prefix_sem D p Mk gs HΨ (gs1 ++ g :: nil) (List.skipn (S n) gs)
                      ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq)) as HC1.
        rewrite cargs_ctx_snoc, <- List.app_assoc in HC1.
        pose proof (rel_ctx_wf_app_r _ _ HC1) as HC0.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HC0) as [R0 HR0].
        assert (HP0 : PER R0) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HR0).
        assert (Lc : forall Y (zs : list domain), List.length Y = im_nn Mk -> List.length zs = n ->
                   List.length ((u0 ++ Y) ++ zs) = List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk))
          by (intros; rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params, u0_len; unfold im_np; lia).
        assert (HE : R0 (env_args nil ((u0 ++ X) ++ fa)) (env_args nil ((u0 ++ X') ++ fa'))).
        { apply (gargs_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HR0 HC0 (Lc _ _ Lna Lfa)).
          rewrite List.rev_app_distr; apply per_gargs_app_intro;
            [ rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_params, List.length_app, u0_len, Lna; unfold im_np; lia | exact Hpg |].
          exact IHk. }
        assert (HEE : R0 (env_args nil ((u0 ++ X) ++ fa)) (env_args nil ((u0 ++ X) ++ fa)))
          by (etransitivity; [ exact HE | symmetry; exact HE ]).
        assert (Hgd : per_gargs (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) nil nil (u0 ++ X ++ fa) (u0 ++ X ++ fa)).
        { assert (HC0' : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) ++ ⋅)
            by (rewrite List.rev_involutive, List.app_nil_r; exact HC0).
          assert (HR0' : EF List.rev (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) ++ ⋅
                           ≈ List.rev (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) ++ ⋅ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R0)
            by (rewrite List.rev_involutive, List.app_nil_r; exact HR0).
          assert (L1 : List.length ((u0 ++ X) ++ fa) = List.length (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)))
            by (rewrite List.length_rev; exact (Lc _ _ Lna Lfa)).
          pose proof (proj2 (rel_gargs _ _ _ _ per_ctx_env_nil_true HC0'
                               (List.Forall_rev (proj2 (List.Forall_app _ _ _) (conj (cargs_ctx_aux_ass _ _ _ _ _) (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMk))))
                               HR0' nil nil _ _ L1 L1 HEE)) as H.
          rewrite <- List.app_assoc in H; exact H. }
        assert (Hpre : forall R, EF cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ≈ cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R ->
                   R (env_args nil (u0 ++ X ++ fa)) (env_args nil (u0 ++ X ++ fa))).
        { intros R HR; assert (E : R0 <~> R) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; eassumption).
          apply E; rewrite List.app_assoc; exact HEE. }
        
The non-recursive arguments before, canonically.
        set (K := List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)).
        assert (Hnv : forall ws, List.length ws = List.length gs -> List.firstn K (nonrec_arg_vals gs ws) = nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn n ws)).
        { intros ws Lw; rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn n ws) at 1.
          rewrite Heq at 1; fold gs1.
          rewrite nonrec_arg_vals_app by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
          rewrite firstn_app_exact by (apply length_nonrec_arg_vals; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia); reflexivity. }
        assert (HKl : K <= List.length (cargs_nonrec gs)) by (unfold K; rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
        assert (Hpk0 : tele_prefix_rel (ar k X c) K (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa')).
        { unfold fa, fa'; rewrite <- (Hnv vs Hlv), <- (Hnv vs' Hlv').
          apply tele_prefix_rel_of_full with (T := cargs_nonrec gs); [ exact Har | exact HKl ]. }
        assert (Hpk : tele_prefix_rel (ar k X c) K (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa))
          by exact (args_rel_pre_refl_l p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI k Mk HMk X c gs Haa Hcon K _ _ HKl Hpk0).
        pose proof Har as Har0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in Har0; destruct Har0 as (_ & _ & Harr).
        destruct g as [A | t]; cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app List.rev] in HC1 |- *.
        - destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HC1) as [j HT].
          destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HR0 HT _ _ HE) as (t & t' & Et & Et' & [R HR]).
          pose proof Et as Et0; rewrite env_args_app in Et, Et'.
          destruct (per_univ_elem_to_nat _ _ _ _ HR) as [m0 Hm0].
          apply (per_gargs_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ m0 R); [ rewrite List.length_rev, length_cargs_ctx; lia | exact IHk
                                                       | exact (mk_rel_mod_eval _ _ Et Et' Hm0) |].
          destruct (vg_arg_head p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs gs1 A _ u0 X fa HMk Hcon Heq u0_len Lna (eq_trans Lfa (eq_sym Lk)) Hgd)
            as (iA0 & Rh & a & Ea & Haa' & ERh).
          rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Et0.
          assert (a = t) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
          assert (E1 : R <~> Rh) by (eapply per_univ_elem_right_irrel; [ exact HR | exact Haa' ]).
          apply E1, ERh.
          assert (HxK : List.nth_error (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) K = Some x /\ List.nth_error (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs') K = Some x').
          { rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn n vs), <- (List.firstn_skipn n vs'); fold fa fa'.
            rewrite (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ Hx), (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ Hx').
            rewrite Heq at 1 2; fold gs1.
            rewrite !nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals].
            rewrite !List.nth_error_app2 by (rewrite length_nonrec_arg_vals by lia; unfold K; lia).
            rewrite !length_nonrec_arg_vals by lia; fold K; rewrite Nat.sub_diag; split; reflexivity. }
          pose proof (Harr K x x' (proj1 HxK) (proj2 HxK)) as Hr; rewrite (Hnv vs Hlv) in Hr; fold fa in Hr.
          exact Hr.
        - destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HC1) as [j HT].
          destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HR0 HT _ _ HE) as (a & a' & Ea & Ea' & [R HR]).
          pose proof Ea as Ea0; rewrite env_args_app in Ea, Ea'.
          destruct (per_univ_elem_to_nat _ _ _ _ HR) as [m0 Hm0].
          apply (per_gargs_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ m0 R); [ rewrite List.length_rev, length_cargs_ctx; lia | exact IHk
                                                       | exact (mk_rel_mod_eval _ _ Ea Ea' Hm0) |].
          pose proof (per_univ_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ HR (per_univ_sym _ _ _ _ HR)) as HRd.
          rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Ea0.
          pose proof (view_end_rel_all P p D HP HPD u0 u0 u0_gargs u0_len (ptyp_mem t)) as Hend.
          pose proof (shape_char p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon HΨ gs1 t _ Heq u0 X fa u0_len Lna (eq_trans Lfa (eq_sym Lk)) u0_gargs Haa Hpk Hpre Hend
                        (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) 0 nil a j R eq_refl (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) ltac:(cbn; constructor)
                        ltac:(rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Ea0) HRd) as ER.
          repeat rewrite List.app_nil_r in ER; cbn [ptyp_skip] in ER.
          apply ER.
          destruct (con_args_rel_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia gs1 t _ Heq) as (y & y' & Hy & Hy' & Hrel).
          rewrite Lk in Hy, Hy', Hrel; rewrite Hx in Hy; injection Hy as <-; rewrite Hx' in Hy'; injection Hy' as <-.
          fold fa fa' in Hrel.
          exact (proj2 (vg_rec_arg_move_right p D Hvg k Mk c gs1 t _ u0 u0 X X' _ _ x x' HMk
                          ltac:(rewrite <- Heq; exact Hcon) u0_gargs u0_len Hab Hpk0) Hrel).
      Qed.

The arguments, at the closed telescope.
      Lemma closed_args_gargs : forall X X' vs vs',
          tele_rel (nr k) T X X' ->
          tele_rel (ar k X c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs') ->
          con_args_rel p D (okr_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 X X' gs vs vs' ->
          forall n, n <= List.length gs ->
          per_gargs (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk (List.firstn n gs) ++ im_nparams Mk)) (env_args nil u0) (env_args nil u0)
            (X ++ List.firstn n vs) (X' ++ List.firstn n vs').
      Proof.
        intros * HX Har Hia n Hn.
        pose proof (cargs_gargs X X' vs vs' HX Har Hia n Hn) as Hc1.
        pose proof HX as HX0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in HX0; destruct HX0 as (LX & LX' & _).
        unfold T in LX, LX'; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in LX, LX'.
        rewrite List.rev_app_distr; apply per_gargs_app_intro;
          [ rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams; exact LX | exact (nparams_closed_of_canon k Mk HMk _ _ HX) |].
        rewrite <- !env_args_app; exact Hc1.
      Qed.
    End ConCanon.

The Motives

The motives of the blocks Bks, each in its member's context, and their family Rel between C1 and an environment C2 related to it: the head relation of the motive at the two extended environments.
    Section Motives.
      Variable (C2 : env).
      Hypothesis (HC12 : RΓ C1 C2).
      Variable (Bks : list eblock) (iA : nat).
      Hypothesis (HBks : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> exists b, List.nth_error Bks j = Some b).
      Hypothesis (HMall : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊨ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ).
      Hypothesis (HAv : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b ->
                    elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ⊨ eb_motive b : Typeω@iA).
      Let Rel := fun j ns m ns' m' =>
        per_head (List.nth j (blocks_motives Bks) a_True) (List.nth j (blocks_motives Bks) a_True)
          (env_args C1 (ns ++ m :: nil)) (env_args C2 (ns' ++ m' :: nil)).

      Lemma mctx_at : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> forall B1 B2, RΓ B1 C1 -> RΓ B2 C1 ->
          forall RM, EF elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ≈ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RM ->
          forall u u' ns ns' m m', G j u u' ns ns' m m' ->
            RM (env_args B1 (ns ++ m :: nil)) (env_args B2 (ns' ++ m' :: nil)).
      Proof.
        intros * HMj * HB1 HB2 RM HRM * Hm.
        exact (cv_mctx j Mj HMj (HMall _ _ HMj) B1 B2 HB1 HB2 RM HRM ns ns' u u' m m' (ins _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hm) Hm).
      Qed.

The family at related elements does not depend on their indices, nor on their bases.
      Lemma rel_move : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> forall u u' ns ns' m m' ns1 ns1',
          G j u u' ns ns' m m' ->
          tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) ns ns1 -> tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) ns' ns1' ->
          (Rel j ns m ns' m' <~> Rel j ns1 m ns1' m').
      Proof.
        intros * HMj * Hm H1 H1'.
        assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
        destruct (HBks j Mj HMj) as [b Hb].
        assert (HC21 : RΓ C2 C1) by (symmetry; exact HC12).
        pose proof (ins _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hm) as Hn.
        pose proof (isym _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as Hms.
        pose proof (trefl_r _ _ HMj _ _ Hn) as Hn'n'.
        pose proof (iidx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hms Hn'n' H1) as Hm2.
        pose proof (iidx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hm H1 H1') as Hm3.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env (HMall _ _ HMj)) as [RM HRM].
        unfold Rel; rewrite (blocks_motives_nth _ _ _ Hb).
        apply (per_head_of_typ_resp HRM (HAv _ _ _ HMj Hb)).
        apply rel_chain_cons; [ exact (mctx_at j Mj HMj C1 C2 HC11 HC21 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) |].
        apply rel_chain_cons; [ exact (mctx_at j Mj HMj C2 C1 HC21 HC11 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm2) |].
        apply rel_chain_of_pair; exact (mctx_at j Mj HMj C1 C2 HC11 HC21 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm3).
      Qed.

      Lemma ind_rel_refl_l : forall j u u' ns ns' m m', G j u u' ns ns' m m' -> G j u u ns ns m m.
      Proof. intros * Hm; exact (itrans _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm _ _ _ _ (isym _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm)). Qed.

      Lemma ind_rel_refl_r : forall j u u' ns ns' m m', G j u u' ns ns' m m' -> G j u' u' ns' ns' m' m'.
      Proof. intros * Hm; exact (itrans _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (isym _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) _ _ _ _ Hm). Qed.

The motive of the member j at C1 and a motive equal to it at C2, at related elements: related at the family.
      Lemma mot_mid : forall j Mj b A0, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b ->
          elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ⊨ eb_motive b ≈ A0 : Typeω@iA ->
          forall u u' ns ns' m m', G j u u' ns ns' m m' ->
          exists a a', ⟦ eb_motive b ⟧ env_args C1 (ns ++ m :: nil) ↘ a /\ ⟦ A0 ⟧ env_args C2 (ns' ++ m' :: nil) ↘ a' /\
            DF a ≈ a' ∈ per_univ_elem iA ↘ Rel j ns m ns' m'.
      Proof.
        intros * HMj Hb HA * Hm.
        assert (HC21 : RΓ C2 C1) by (symmetry; exact HC12).
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env (HMall _ _ HMj)) as [RM HRM].
        pose proof (mctx_at j Mj HMj C1 C2 HC11 HC21 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as HE.
        pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HA) as HAl.
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRM HA _ _ HE) as (a & a' & Ea & Ea' & Haa).
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRM HAl _ _ HE) as (b0 & d & Eb & Ed & Hbd).
        assert (b0 = a) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        exists a, a'; split; [ exact Ea | split; [ exact Ea' |] ].
        unfold Rel; rewrite (blocks_motives_nth _ _ _ Hb).
        eapply univ_connect; [ etransitivity; [ exact Hbd | symmetry; exact Hbd ] | exact (per_univ_elem_at_head Ea Ed Hbd) |].
        etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact Haa | exact Hbd ].
      Qed.

The motive moved by a semantic substitution σ0 from Γ' at ρ0, against a motive equal to it at the value ρ0σ0 of σ0, of the class of C1.
      Lemma mot_out : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b ->
          forall Γ' RΓ' σ0 ρ0 ρ0σ0 A0, EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ' -> Γ' ⊨ˢ σ0 ≈ σ0 : Γ ->
          RΓ' ρ0 ρ0 -> ⟦ σ0 ⟧s ρ0 ↘ ρ0σ0 -> RΓ ρ0σ0 C1 ->
          elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ⊨ eb_motive b ≈ A0 : Typeω@iA ->
          forall u u' ns ns' m m', G j u u' ns ns' m m' ->
            exists a a', ⟦ A0[sb_qn (S (im_nn Mj)) σ0] ⟧ env_args ρ0 (ns ++ m :: nil) ↘ a /\
              ⟦ A0 ⟧ env_args ρ0σ0 (ns' ++ m' :: nil) ↘ a' /\ DF a ≈ a' ∈ per_univ_elem iA ↘ Rel j ns m ns' m'.
      Proof.
        intros * HMj Hb * HRΓ' Hσ0 Hρ0 Hev0 HρC HA0 * Hm.
        assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
        assert (HC21 : RΓ C2 C1) by (symmetry; exact HC12).
        pose proof (HMall _ _ HMj) as HM.
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HM) as [RM HRM].
        pose proof (ins _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hm) as Hns.
        pose proof (trefl_l _ _ HMj _ _ Hns) as Hnn.
        pose proof (ind_rel_refl_l _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as Hmm.
        pose proof (ind_rel_refl_r _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as Hmm'.
        pose proof (HAv _ _ _ HMj Hb) as HAl.
        pose proof (mctx_at j Mj HMj ρ0σ0 ρ0σ0 HρC HρC RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hmm) as El.
        assert (Ll : List.length (ns ++ m :: nil) = List.length (List.rev (elim_mctx p D j Mj Us))).
        { pose proof Hnn as H; rewrite tele_rel_iff in H; destruct H as (H & _).
          rewrite List.length_rev, length_elim_mctx, List.length_app; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in H; cbn; lia. }
        assert (HMr : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev (elim_mctx p D j Mj Us)) ++ Γ) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HM).
        assert (HRMr : EF List.rev (List.rev (elim_mctx p D j Mj Us)) ++ Γ ≈ List.rev (List.rev (elim_mctx p D j Mj Us)) ++ Γ
                         ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RM)
          by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HRM).
        pose proof (proj2 (rel_gargs _ _ _ _ HRΓ HMr (List.Forall_rev (elim_mctx_ass p D j Mj Us Hc HMj)) HRMr _ _ _ _ Ll Ll El)) as Hg.
        destruct (outer_typ_link (elim_mctx p D j Mj Us) Γ Γ' RΓ' σ0 ρ0 ρ0σ0 A0 A0 iA (elim_mctx_ass p D j Mj Us Hc HMj) HM
                    (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_right HA0) HRΓ' Hσ0 Hρ0 Hev0 _ Hg ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev in Ll; exact Ll))
          as (a & b0 & Ea & Eb0 & Hab0).
        rewrite length_elim_mctx in Ea.
        pose proof (mctx_at j Mj HMj C1 C2 HC11 HC21 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as Ebc.
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRM HAl _ _ Ebc) as (b1 & c0 & Eb & Ec & Hbc).
        pose proof (mctx_at j Mj HMj C1 ρ0σ0 HC11 HρC RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hmm) as E1.
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRM HA0 _ _ E1) as (b' & b0' & Eb' & Eb0' & Hbb0).
        assert (b' = b1) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        assert (b0' = b0) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        pose proof (mctx_at j Mj HMj C2 ρ0σ0 HC21 HρC RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hmm') as E2.
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRM HA0 _ _ E2) as (c' & d & Ec' & Ed & Hcd).
        assert (c' = c0) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        exists a, d; split; [ exact Ea | split; [ exact Ed |] ].
        unfold Rel; rewrite (blocks_motives_nth _ _ _ Hb).
        eapply univ_connect; [ etransitivity; [ exact Hab0 | symmetry; exact Hbb0 ] | exact (per_univ_elem_at_head Eb Ec Hbc) |].
        symmetry; exact Hcd.
      Qed.

The family along related elements.
      Lemma rel_resp : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> forall u1 u2 u3 u4 u5 u6 ns1 m1 ns2 m2 ns3 m3 ns4 m4,
          G j u1 u2 ns1 ns2 m1 m2 -> G j u3 u4 ns2 ns3 m2 m3 -> G j u5 u6 ns3 ns4 m3 m4 ->
          (Rel j ns1 m1 ns2 m2 <~> Rel j ns3 m3 ns4 m4).
      Proof.
        intros * HMj * M12 M23 M34.
        assert (HC21 : RΓ C2 C1) by (symmetry; exact HC12).
        destruct (HBks j Mj HMj) as [b Hb].
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env (HMall _ _ HMj)) as [RM HRM].
        unfold Rel; rewrite (blocks_motives_nth _ _ _ Hb).
        apply (per_head_of_typ_resp HRM (HAv _ _ _ HMj Hb)).
        apply rel_chain_cons; [ exact (mctx_at j Mj HMj C1 C2 HC11 HC21 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ M12) |].
        apply rel_chain_cons; [ exact (mctx_at j Mj HMj C2 C1 HC21 HC11 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ M23) |].
        apply rel_chain_of_pair; exact (mctx_at j Mj HMj C1 C2 HC11 HC21 RM HRM _ _ _ _ _ _ M34).
      Qed.

      Lemma rel_per : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> forall u u' ns ns' m m',
          G j u u' ns ns' m m' -> PER (Rel j ns m ns' m').
      Proof.
        intros * HMj * Hm.
        destruct (HBks j Mj HMj) as [b Hb].
        destruct (mot_mid j Mj b (eb_motive b) HMj Hb (HAv _ _ _ HMj Hb) _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as (a & a' & _ & _ & H).
        eapply per_elem_PER; exact H.
      Qed.

Recursive results related at any bases are related at u0: the end's parameters at u0 are related to the ones at the bases (okr_at), and the family does not depend on them.
      Lemma rec_result_rebase : forall kr t u u' pre pre' v v' ih ih',
          rec_arg_rel p D (okr_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr kr u u' pre pre' t v v' ->
          rec_result_rel dr Rel kr u u' pre pre' t v v' ih ih' ->
          rec_result_rel dr Rel kr u0 u0 pre pre' t v v' ih ih'.
      Proof.
        intros kr t; induction t as [j Ps | B t IH]; intros * Ha Hr.
        - destruct (rec_arg_self_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ha) as (bs & bs' & Ebs & Ebs' & [o Eo Ho] & [o' Eo' Ho'] & Hir).
          destruct (rec_result_self_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr) as (cs & cs' & Ecs & Ecs' & Hrr).
          pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecs Ebs) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecs' Ebs') as ->.
          unfold ntele_rel in Ho, Ho'; destruct (ind_member D j) as [Mj |] eqn:HMj; [| contradiction ].
          eapply rec_result_self; [ exact Eo | exact Eo' |].
          exact (proj1 (rel_move j Mj HMj _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hir (tsym _ _ HMj _ _ Ho) (tsym _ _ HMj _ _ Ho') ih ih') Hrr).
        - constructor; intros c0 c0' Hc0.
          destruct (rec_result_pi_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr c0 c0' Hc0) as (fc & fc' & r & r' & Efc & Efc' & Er & Er' & Hr').
          destruct (rec_arg_pi_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ha c0 c0' Hc0) as (g & g' & Eg & Eg' & Ha').
          assert (g = fc) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_app; eassumption).
          assert (g' = fc') as -> by (eapply functional_eval_app; eassumption).
          econstructor; [ exact Efc | exact Efc' | exact Er | exact Er' | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ha' Hr') ].
      Qed.

      Lemma rec_results_rebase : forall kr u u' pre pre' gs vs vs' ihs ihs',
          con_args_rel p D (okr_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr kr u u' pre pre' gs vs vs' ->
          rec_results_rel dr Rel kr u u' pre pre' gs vs vs' ihs ihs' ->
          rec_results_rel dr Rel kr u0 u0 pre pre' gs vs vs' ihs ihs'.
      Proof.
        intros * Ha Hr; revert Ha; induction Hr; intros Ha; inversion Ha; subst.
        - constructor.
        - apply rec_results_arg; apply IHHr; assumption.
        - apply rec_results_rec; [ eapply rec_result_rebase; eassumption | apply IHHr; assumption ].
      Qed.

The Branches' Contexts

The branch of a constructor c of the member k, with arguments gs: its context, the non-uniform parameters, the arguments and the recursive results, each at the motive of the member its argument's shape ends in.
      Section Branch.
        Variable (k : nat) (Mk : imember) (c : String.string) (gs : list carg).
        Hypotheses (HMk : ind_member D k = Some Mk) (Hcon : ind_con Mk c = Some gs).
        Hypothesis (HB : ⊨ elim_bctx p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ).
        Let HΨ := vg_cargs_sem p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon.
        Let As := blocks_motives Bks.
        Let T := List.rev (im_nparams Mk).

        Lemma bctx_split : elim_bctx p D Mk gs As Us ++ Γ = ihs_ctx_aux (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs ++ cinst Γ p D Mk Us gs.
        Proof. unfold elim_bctx, cinst; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity. Qed.

        Lemma ihs_pre_sem : forall gs1 gs2, gs = gs1 ++ gs2 ->
            ⊨ ihs_ctx_aux (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1 ++ cinst Γ p D Mk Us gs.
        Proof.
          intros * Heq; pose proof HB as H; fold As in H; rewrite bctx_split in H.
          replace (ihs_ctx_aux (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs)
            with (ihs_ctx_aux (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1 ++ nil) (0 + cargs_nrec gs1) gs2
                  ++ ihs_ctx_aux (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1) in H
            by (rewrite <- ihs_ctx_aux_app, <- Heq; reflexivity).
          rewrite <- List.app_assoc in H; exact (rel_ctx_wf_app_r _ _ H).
        Qed.

The Recursive Result of a Recursive Argument

The recursive result of a recursive argument x of shape t is of a Π over the shape's domains, moved by σ into the branch's context, of the motive of the member jt the shape ends in, at the shape's parameters and x applied to the domains.
        Section Entry.
          #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
          Variable (gs1 : list carg) (t : ptyp) (gs2 : list carg).
          Hypothesis (Heq : gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2).
          Let pat := cargs_pat gs1.
          Let K := List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1).
          Let E := ihs_ctx_aux (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1.
          Let Ctx := E ++ cinst Γ p D Mk Us gs.
          Let jr := cargs_nrec gs1.
          Let na := List.length gs.
          Let σ := ihs_sub (im_nn Mk) Us na pat jr.
          Let m := jr + na + im_nn Mk.
          Let β := sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn m).
          Let idx := jr + na - 1 - List.length pat.
          Let L := List.length (ptyp_doms t).
          Let Tg := cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ++ Γ.

          Lemma e_LE : List.length E = jr.
          Proof. apply length_ihs_ctx_aux. Qed.

          Lemma e_Lpat : List.length pat = List.length gs1.
          Proof. apply length_cargs_pat. Qed.

          Lemma e_Lna : na = List.length gs1 + S (List.length gs2).
          Proof. unfold na; rewrite Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia. Qed.

          Lemma e_HK : K <= List.length (cargs_nonrec gs).
          Proof. unfold K; rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia. Qed.

          Lemma e_strat : cargs_strat gs1 = nonrec_args_prefix gs (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)).
          Proof. rewrite Heq; apply nonrec_args_prefix_cargs_strat. Qed.

          Lemma entry_eq : ihs_ctx_aux (im_nn Mk) As Us na nil 0 (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil)
                           = ce_ass (ptyp_ihty As β σ (a_var idx) t) :: E.
          Proof.
            unfold E, β, σ, m, idx, jr, na, pat; rewrite ihs_ctx_aux_app, List.app_nil_r; cbn [ihs_ctx_aux List.app Nat.add].
            reflexivity.
          Qed.

          Lemma e_HCtx : ⊨ Ctx.
          Proof. exact (ihs_pre_sem gs1 _ Heq). Qed.

          Lemma e_HCtxT : ⊨ Ctx ▹ ptyp_ihty As β σ (a_var idx) t.
          Proof.
            pose proof (ihs_pre_sem (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) gs2 ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq)) as H.
            change (List.length gs) with na in H; rewrite entry_eq in H; exact H.
          Qed.

          Lemma e_Ksem : ⊨ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk.
          Proof. rewrite e_strat; apply (vid_strat _ HD k Mk c gs); [ exact HMk | exact Hcon | exact e_HK ]. Qed.

          Lemma e_Kass : tele_ass (cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk).
          Proof.
            apply List.Forall_app; split;
              [ rewrite cargs_strat_nonrec; apply List.Forall_rev, tele_ass_map_ass | exact (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMk) ].
          Qed.

          Lemma e_Tg : ⊨ Tg.
          Proof.
            destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ e_Kass e_Ksem HΓ) as [H _]; unfold Tg; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in H; exact H.
          Qed.

The components' substitution.
          Lemma gsub_sigma : gsub Ctx σ Tg.
          Proof.
            assert (Hp1 : ⊨ cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk) by exact (cargs_prefix_sem D p Mk gs HΨ gs1 _ Heq).
            assert (Hp1a : tele_ass (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk))
              by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMk) ]).
            destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ Hp1a Hp1 HΓ) as [HΨ1Γ _].
            pose proof (gsub_wk _ _ _ (cargs_wk_ext k Mk c gs HMk Hcon gs1 _ Heq) ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΨ1Γ; exact HΨ1Γ) e_Tg)
              as G0.
            assert (Hτ2 : gsub (cinst Γ p D Mk Us gs1) (sb_qn (List.length pat + im_nn Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us))
                            (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ++ Γ)).
            { rewrite cinst_eq.
              replace (List.length pat + im_nn Mk) with (List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_nparams Mk))
                by (rewrite List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_nparams, e_Lpat; lia).
              replace (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ++ Γ) with ((cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_nparams Mk) ++ ind_uparams D ++ Γ)
                by (unfold im_params; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
              apply gsub_qn; [ exact gsub_U | apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (member_nparams_ass D Hc _ _ HMk) ] |].
              unfold im_params in HΨ1Γ; repeat rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HΨ1Γ; repeat rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact HΨ1Γ. }
            destruct (gsub_props Hτ2) as [Hτ2v Hτ2l].
            pose proof (gsub_comp _ _ _ _ _ G0 (gsub_rel_ctx_wf _ _ _ Hτ2) Hτ2v Hτ2l) as G1.
            assert (Hw3 : Ctx ⊨ʷ (wk_shiftn (na - List.length pat + jr)) : cinst Γ p D Mk Us gs1).
            { pose proof e_HCtx as H0; unfold Ctx in H0 |- *.
              rewrite Heq in H0 |- *; rewrite cinst_split in H0 |- *; rewrite List.app_assoc in H0 |- *.
              match goal with |- ?C ++ _ ⊨ʷ _ : _ => replace (na - List.length pat + jr) with (List.length C) end.
              - apply rel_wk_under_ctx_shiftn; exact H0.
              - rewrite !List.length_app, length_tele_sub, length_cargs_ctx_aux, e_LE, e_Lna, e_Lpat; cbn; lia. }
            exact (gsub_comp _ _ _ _ _ G1 e_HCtx (rel_sub_of_wk Hw3) (sub_link_wk Hw3)).
          Qed.

The environments of the branch's context there.
          Variable (RS : relation env).
          Hypothesis (HRS : EF Ctx ≈ Ctx ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RS).

          Lemma e_ctx_split : Ctx = (E ++ tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) τU) ++ Γ.
          Proof. unfold Ctx; rewrite cinst_eq, List.app_assoc; reflexivity. Qed.

          Lemma e_Lm : forall (X fa : list domain) (v : domain) (aft ihp : list domain), List.length X = im_nn Mk ->
              List.length fa = List.length gs1 -> List.length aft = List.length gs2 -> List.length ihp = jr ->
              List.length (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp) = m.
          Proof. intros; unfold m; rewrite e_Lna; rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; rewrite List.length_app; lia. Qed.

          Lemma side_w : forall B X fa v aft ihp, RΓ B C1 ->
              List.length X = im_nn Mk -> List.length fa = List.length gs1 ->
              List.length aft = List.length gs2 -> List.length ihp = jr ->
              RS (env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp)) (env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp)) ->
              exists w, ⟦ List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn m]ʷ) Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp) ↘ w /\
                RU (env_args nil w) (env_args nil u0) /\ List.length w = ind_nu D.
          Proof.
            intros * HBC LX Lfa Laft Lihp HE.
            assert (HPU : PER RU) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRU).
            pose proof HRS as HRS'; rewrite e_ctx_split in HRS'.
            pose proof e_HCtx as HC'; rewrite e_ctx_split in HC'.
            assert (Ll : List.length (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp) = List.length (E ++ tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) τU)).
            { rewrite (e_Lm _ _ _ _ _ LX Lfa Laft Lihp), List.length_app, length_tele_sub, List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx,
                length_im_nparams, e_LE.
              unfold m, na; lia. }
            destruct (us_wk_vals _ _ B _ HRS' HC' HE Ll) as (w & uB & Hw & HuB & Hwu).
            rewrite <- Ll, (e_Lm _ _ _ _ _ LX Lfa Laft Lihp) in Hw.
            destruct (us_class B HBC) as (uB' & HuB' & HuB0).
            pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ HuB HuB') as <-.
            exists w; split; [ exact Hw | split; [ etransitivity; eassumption |] ].
            rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Hw), List.length_map; exact HUl.
          Qed.

          Lemma sigma_side : forall B X fa v aft ihp w,
              List.length X = im_nn Mk -> List.length fa = List.length gs1 ->
              List.length aft = List.length gs2 -> List.length ihp = jr ->
              ⟦ List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn m]ʷ) Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp) ↘ w ->
              ⟦ σ ⟧s env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp) ↘ env_args B (w ++ X ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa).
          Proof.
            intros * LX Lfa Laft Lihp Hw.
            assert (Hna : na = List.length gs1 + S (List.length aft)) by (rewrite e_Lna, Laft; reflexivity).
            unfold σ, m in *; rewrite Hna in *.
            exact (ihs_sub_eval (im_nn Mk) Us gs1 aft jr B X fa v ihp w LX Lfa Lihp Hw).
          Qed.

The canonical arguments of the closed telescope of the domains.
          Lemma e_canon_gargs : forall kd ms ms' ws ws' ys ys', kd <= L ->
              tele_rel (nr k) T ms ms' -> tele_prefix_rel (ar k ms c) K ws ws' ->
              tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (dr k) ms ws (ptyp_doms t)) kd ys ys' ->
              per_gargs (List.rev (doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) nil nil
                (u0 ++ ms ++ ws ++ ys) (u0 ++ ms' ++ ws' ++ ys').
          Proof.
            intros * Hk Hm Hw Hy.
            destruct (sort_value D HD u0 u0_gargs u0_len) as [a0 Ha0].
            pose proof Hm as Hm0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in Hm0; destruct Hm0 as (Lms & Lms' & _).
            unfold T in Lms, Lms'; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in Lms, Lms'.
            pose proof Hw as Hw0; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hw0; destruct Hw0 as (Lws & Lws' & _).
            pose proof (params_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk u0 u0 a0 ms ms' u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 Hm) as Hpg.
            pose proof (ar_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk c gs u0 u0 a0 ms ms' Hcon u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 Hm K ws ws' e_HK Hw) as Hgv.
            pose proof (dom_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk c gs gs1 t gs2 u0 u0 a0 ms ms' ws ws' Hcon Heq u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 Hm Hw kd ys ys' Hk Hy)
              as Hgd.
            rewrite e_strat; unfold nonrec_args_prefix, doms_ctx.
            rewrite !List.rev_app_distr, !List.rev_involutive, <- List.firstn_map.
            rewrite (List.app_assoc u0), (List.app_assoc (u0 ++ ms)), (List.app_assoc u0 ms'), (List.app_assoc (u0 ++ ms')).
            pose proof e_HK as HK0.
            apply per_gargs_app_intro;
              [ rewrite !List.length_app, List.length_rev, List.length_firstn, List.length_map, length_im_params, u0_len;
                unfold K, im_np in *; lia | |].
            - apply per_gargs_app_intro; [ rewrite List.length_app, List.length_rev, length_im_params, u0_len; unfold im_np; lia
                                         | exact Hpg | exact Hgv ].
            - rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Hgd.
          Qed.

          Lemma e_dctx : forall kd, kd <= L -> ⊨ doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk.
          Proof. intros kd Hk; rewrite e_strat; exact (vid_dctx _ HD k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 kd HMk Hcon Heq Hk). Qed.

          Lemma e_dass : forall kd, tele_ass (doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk).
          Proof. intros; apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply List.Forall_rev, tele_ass_map_ass | exact e_Kass ]. Qed.

          Lemma e_dlen : forall kd, kd <= L -> List.length (doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t))) = kd.
          Proof. intros; rewrite doms_ctx_length, List.length_firstn; unfold L in *; lia. Qed.

A side's environment of the closed telescope, against the canonical one.
          Lemma closed_link : forall kd B w X nvs ys, kd <= L -> RU (env_args nil w) (env_args nil u0) -> List.length w = ind_nu D ->
              List.length X = im_nn Mk -> List.length nvs = K -> List.length ys = kd ->
              per_gargs (List.rev (doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) nil nil
                (u0 ++ X ++ nvs ++ ys) (u0 ++ X ++ nvs ++ ys) ->
              forall RK, EF doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk
                           ≈ doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RK ->
                RK (env_args (env_args B (w ++ X ++ nvs)) ys) (env_args nil (u0 ++ X ++ nvs ++ ys)).
          Proof.
            intros * Hk Hw Lw LX Lnvs Lys Hg RK HRK.
            set (Pre := doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_nparams Mk).
            assert (HPe : Pre ++ ind_uparams D = doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)
              by (unfold Pre, im_params; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
            assert (LPre : List.length Pre = List.length (X ++ nvs ++ ys))
              by (unfold Pre; rewrite !List.length_app, e_dlen, length_im_nparams, cargs_strat_nonrec, List.length_rev, List.length_map
                    by exact Hk; fold K; lia).
            rewrite <- HPe in Hg, HRK.
            rewrite List.rev_app_distr in Hg.
            destruct (per_gargs_app _ _ _ _ u0 u0 (X ++ nvs ++ ys) (X ++ nvs ++ ys)
                        ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact u0_len) Hg ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact u0_len)) as [_ Hg1].
            replace (env_args (env_args B (w ++ X ++ nvs)) ys) with (env_args (env_args B w) (X ++ nvs ++ ys))
              by (rewrite <- !env_args_app, <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
            apply (closed_pre_base Pre RK); [ rewrite HPe; apply e_dass | rewrite HPe; apply e_dctx, Hk | exact HRK
                                             | exact Hw | exact Lw | exact Hg1 | exact (eq_sym LPre) ].
          Qed.

The domains' arguments at a side's value of the components.
          Lemma side_dom_gargs : forall kd B w X nvs ys, kd <= L -> RU (env_args nil w) (env_args nil u0) -> List.length w = ind_nu D ->
              List.length X = im_nn Mk -> List.length nvs = K ->
              tele_rel (nr k) T X X -> tele_prefix_rel (ar k X c) K nvs nvs ->
              tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (dr k) X nvs (ptyp_doms t)) kd ys ys ->
              per_gargs (List.rev (doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t)))) (env_args B (w ++ X ++ nvs)) (env_args B (w ++ X ++ nvs)) ys ys.
          Proof.
            intros * Hk Hw Lw LX Lnvs HX Hnvs Hys.
            destruct (sort_value D HD u0 u0_gargs u0_len) as [a0 Ha0].
            pose proof (dom_gargs D HD Hc Hsu k Mk HMk c gs gs1 t gs2 u0 u0 a0 X X nvs nvs Hcon Heq u0_gargs u0_len Ha0 HX Hnvs kd ys ys Hk Hys)
              as Hgd.
            assert (HK0 : ⊨ cargs_strat gs1 ++ im_params D Mk) by exact e_Ksem.
            destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HK0) as [RK0 HRK0].
            assert (HPK : PER RK0) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRK0).
            pose proof (e_canon_gargs 0 X X nvs nvs nil nil ltac:(lia) HX Hnvs (tele_prefix_rel_nil _)) as Hg0.
            cbn [List.firstn doms_ctx List.map List.rev List.app] in Hg0; rewrite List.app_nil_r in Hg0.
            assert (Hc0 : RK0 (env_args B (w ++ X ++ nvs)) (env_args nil (u0 ++ X ++ nvs))).
            { pose proof (closed_link 0 B w X nvs nil ltac:(lia) Hw Lw LX Lnvs eq_refl) as H.
              cbn [List.firstn doms_ctx List.map List.rev List.app env_args List.fold_left] in H; rewrite !List.app_nil_r in H.
              apply H; [ exact Hg0 | exact HRK0 ]. }
            assert (Hcc : RK0 (env_args nil (u0 ++ X ++ nvs)) (env_args nil (u0 ++ X ++ nvs))).
            { apply (gargs_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HRK0 HK0);
                [ rewrite !List.length_app, cargs_strat_nonrec, List.length_rev, List.length_map, length_im_params, u0_len;
                  fold K; unfold im_np; lia | exact Hg0 ]. }
            eapply (per_gargs_base _ _ _ HRK0); [ rewrite List.rev_involutive; apply e_dctx, Hk
                                                | unfold doms_ctx; rewrite List.rev_involutive; apply tele_ass_map_ass
                                                | exact Hcc | symmetry; exact Hc0 | symmetry; exact Hc0 |].
            unfold doms_ctx; rewrite List.rev_involutive, <- List.firstn_map; exact Hgd.
          Qed.

The domain of the kd-th step at a side, against its canonical value.
          Lemma dom_link : forall kd Bk, List.nth_error (ptyp_doms t) kd = Some Bk ->
              forall B X fa v aft ihp w ys a,
              List.length X = im_nn Mk -> List.length fa = List.length gs1 ->
              List.length aft = List.length gs2 -> List.length ihp = jr -> List.length ys = kd ->
              RS (env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp)) (env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp)) ->
              ⟦ List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn m]ʷ) Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp) ↘ w ->
              RU (env_args nil w) (env_args nil u0) -> List.length w = ind_nu D ->
              tele_rel (nr k) T X X -> tele_prefix_rel (ar k X c) K (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa) ->
              tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (dr k) X (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa) (ptyp_doms t)) kd ys ys ->
              ⟦ Bk[sb_qn kd σ] ⟧ env_args (env_args B (X ++ fa ++ v :: aft ++ ihp)) ys ↘ a ->
              exists b (i : nat), ⟦ Bk ⟧ env_args nil (u0 ++ X ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa ++ ys) ↘ b /\ Dom a ≈ b ∈ per_univ i.
          Proof.
            intros * HBk * LX Lfa Laft Lihp Lys HE Hw HwU Lw HX Hnvs Hys Ea.
            assert (Hk : kd < L) by (unfold L; apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
            set (Δ := doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t))).
            assert (LΔ : List.length Δ = kd) by (apply e_dlen; lia).
            assert (Lnv : List.length (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa) = K) by (apply length_nonrec_arg_vals; exact Lfa).
            destruct (vid_dom _ HD k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 kd Bk HMk Hcon Heq HBk) as (_ & i0 & HBv).
            rewrite <- e_strat in HBv; fold Δ in HBv.
            pose proof (e_dctx kd ltac:(lia)) as HKk; fold Δ in HKk.
            pose proof (e_dass kd) as HKka; fold Δ in HKka.
            assert (HΔa : tele_ass Δ) by (unfold Δ, doms_ctx; apply List.Forall_rev, tele_ass_map_ass).
            destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ HKka HKk HΓ) as [HKkΓ _].
            rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in HKkΓ.
            pose proof (closed_app_valid _ _ _ _ _ HKka HKk HΓ HBv) as HBvΓ; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in HBvΓ.
            pose proof (sigma_side _ _ _ _ _ _ _ LX Lfa Laft Lihp Hw) as Hσe.
            pose proof (side_dom_gargs kd B w X (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa) ys ltac:(lia) HwU Lw LX Lnv HX Hnvs Hys) as Hgy; fold Δ in Hgy.
            destruct (outer_typ_link Δ Tg Ctx RS σ _ _ Bk Bk i0 HΔa HKkΓ HBvΓ HRS (gsub_valid gsub_sigma) HE Hσe ys Hgy
                        ltac:(rewrite LΔ; exact Lys)) as (a' & b' & Ea' & Eb' & Hab).
            rewrite LΔ in Ea'; assert (a' = a) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
            destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HKk) as [RK HRK].
            pose proof (closed_link kd B w X _ ys ltac:(lia) HwU Lw LX Lnv Lys
                          (e_canon_gargs kd X X _ _ ys ys ltac:(lia) HX Hnvs Hys) RK HRK) as HEK.
            destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRK HBv _ _ HEK) as (b1 & b & Eb1 & Eb & Hbb).
            assert (b1 = b') as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
            exists b, i0; split; [ exact Eb | etransitivity; [ exact Hab | exact Hbb ] ].
          Qed.

The canonical arguments and the side's, one prefix along.
